suggestions: pre-filter a large table as a CTE before the join
reorder joins to reduce intermediate rows
optimized_sql:
WITH tn_states AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT DISTINCT s_state
    FROM store
    WHERE s_state IN ('TN', 'TN', 'TN', 'TN', 'TN', 'TN')
)
SELECT i_item_id,
       sales_filtered.s_state,
       grouping(sales_filtered.s_state) g_state,
       avg(sales_filtered.ss_quantity) agg1,
       avg(sales_filtered.ss_list_price) agg2,
       avg(sales_filtered.ss_coupon_amt) agg3,
       avg(sales_filtered.ss_sales_price) agg4
FROM item
JOIN (
    SELECT store_sales.ss_item_sk,
           store_sales.ss_quantity,
           store_sales.ss_list_price,
           store_sales.ss_coupon_amt,
           store_sales.ss_sales_price,
           store.s_state
    FROM store_sales
    JOIN date_dim
      ON store_sales.ss_sold_date_sk = date_dim.d_date_sk
     AND date_dim.d_year = 1999
    JOIN store
      ON store_sales.ss_store_sk = store.s_store_sk
     AND store.s_state IN ('TN', 'TN', 'TN', 'TN', 'TN', 'TN')
    JOIN tn_states
      ON store.s_state = tn_states.s_state
    JOIN customer_demographics
      ON store_sales.ss_cdemo_sk = customer_demographics.cd_demo_sk
     AND customer_demographics.cd_gender = 'M'
     AND customer_demographics.cd_marital_status = 'W'
     AND customer_demographics.cd_education_status = 'Secondary'
) AS sales_filtered
  ON sales_filtered.ss_item_sk = item.i_item_sk
GROUP BY ROLLUP (i_item_id, sales_filtered.s_state)
ORDER BY i_item_id, sales_filtered.s_state
LIMIT 100
